reason: All 4 normative requirements of FR-05 map to meaningful assertions: capacity TASKQ_RATE_BURST (tests/test_fr05.py:288 first 429 at request 21; line 432 success ceiling), 429+Retry-After+problem+json (tests/test_fr05.py:321, 331, 343, 348), DB row-level lock via behavioral proof (tests/test_fr05.py:432 no-overdraft under contention; line 488 DB row exists; line 501 tokens in valid range), /healthz+/readyz exempt (tests/test_fr05.py:571, 591, 759, 784).

gaps.message: Refill rate TASKQ_RATE_PER_SEC is only weakly tested: test_consume_uses_rate_per_sec_for_retry_after monkey-patches the repo to return a hardcoded 1.0/5.0 and asserts only retry_after_seconds > 0, which is true for any positive number. The capacity boundary test (line 288) would catch fast/infinite refill (all 25 succeed → no first 429 at 21) but would NOT catch a zero or very slow refill (still first 429 at 21). The actual env-driven rate TASKQ_RATE_PER_SEC is not directly asserted against any rate-specific computation.
